historical_source_roles.qualification: Full body read only for this exact physical-p16 role; no current revision, historical alias, complete connected trace or independent lens completion is implied.

observations: Historical travel-to-case-site reducers require the strategic gateway, a living party leader, disclosed exact destination and matched authoritative origin; they synchronize departure and revalidate the party before building or validating a journey. The non-planned path constructs a straight-line route whose binding digest incorporates departure, endpoints, geographic flag, distance and minutes; route, weather and coordinate checks require their own connected review.

Historical settlement travel admits a ready evacuation companion in specified party cases, validates route and weather, computes a connected-road or fallback duration, and then either commits a camp or interruption or completes arrival. Zero-distance case-site return takes a separate arrival path. Continue-camp travel checks current camp identity and fireplace custody before refreshing the forecast. These are source observations, not proof that all transitions or linked states are correct.

Party fatigue and itinerary configuration accept primitive percent, minutes and night flag fields after range checks; a journey departure minute is parsed into a minute-of-day value before its raw value is stored. The reducers verify the supplied living character is party leader, while the visible wrappers differ in gateway and character-authority checks. Trace caller authentication and each setting across current producers and consumers before assigning a finding.

Arrival and continuing-camp branches update character and party locations, needs and encounter/objective consequences through different helper sequences. Error propagation, authority boundaries, time advancement and behavioral equivalence need a connected trace. No product build, test or runtime probe ran.
remaining: Trace current route ownership, coordinate admission, case-site versus settlement access, caller authentication for party settings, itinerary and fatigue bounds, full journey and arrival side effects including errors, current source applicability and historical aliases; assess each independent lens separately.
